g.text: Module-level wiring: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1, WeAct 3.7in EPD, microSD, TP4056, TPS63020

g.desc: Module-level wiring: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1, WeAct 3.7in EPD, microSD, TP4056, TPS63020

fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Active-low to GND, internal pull-ups (no resistors).

g.desc: Active-low to GND, internal pull-ups (no resistors).

g.text: All on RTC GPIOs: any button can wake from deep sleep (ext1).

g.desc: All on RTC GPIOs: any button can wake from deep sleep (ext1).

g.text: Parts not in the kit: SW1 slide switch, SW2–SW4 tactile buttons, R1/R2 100k, C1 100nF.

g.desc: Parts not in the kit: SW1 slide switch, SW2–SW4 tactile buttons, R1/R2 100k, C1 100nF.

g.text: 1. Never power the board from the DevKit USB while SW1 is ON. Espressif lists USB, the 5V pin and the 3V3 pin

g.desc: 1. Never power the board from the DevKit USB while SW1 is ON. Espressif lists USB, the 5V pin and the 3V3 pin

g.text: as mutually exclusive supplies, and here TPS63020 drives 3V3 directly. Switch off before flashing.

g.desc: as mutually exclusive supplies, and here TPS63020 drives 3V3 directly. Switch off before flashing.

g.text: 2. TP4056: use the 6-pad version with DW01 protection. System ground is OUT−. Charge through its own USB port;

g.desc: 2. TP4056: use the 6-pad version with DW01 protection. System ground is OUT−. Charge through its own USB port;

g.text: the device can run while charging (OUT+ follows the charger).

g.desc: the device can run while charging (OUT+ follows the charger).

g.text: 3. microSD module: if it carries an AMS1117 regulator it expects 5 V. At 3.3 V either buy a 3.3 V-direct module

g.desc: 3. microSD module: if it carries an AMS1117 regulator it expects 5 V. At 3.3 V either buy a 3.3 V-direct module

g.text: or bridge the regulator IN to OUT.

g.desc: or bridge the regulator IN to OUT.

g.text: 4. Left unconnected on purpose: IO35–37 (octal PSRAM on N16R8), IO0/IO3/IO45/IO46 (strapping),

g.desc: 4. Left unconnected on purpose: IO35–37 (octal PSRAM on N16R8), IO0/IO3/IO45/IO46 (strapping),

g.text: IO19/IO20 (native USB), IO43/IO44 (UART0 console), IO38 (on-board RGB LED).

g.desc: IO19/IO20 (native USB), IO43/IO44 (UART0 console), IO38 (on-board RGB LED).

g.text: 5. Display and microSD share SPI2: SCK IO12, MOSI IO11, MISO IO13. Separate chip selects IO10 / IO14.

g.desc: 5. Display and microSD share SPI2: SCK IO12, MOSI IO11, MISO IO13. Separate chip selects IO10 / IO14.

g.text: Keep the SD on its own CS and deselect both before init.

g.desc: Keep the SD on its own CS and deselect both before init.

g.text: 6. Battery: 1S LiPo, 3.0–4.2 V. TPS63020 runs from 1.8–5.5 V, so the 3.3 V rail holds

g.desc: 6. Battery: 1S LiPo, 3.0–4.2 V. TPS63020 runs from 1.8–5.5 V, so the 3.3 V rail holds

g.text: all the way down to cut-off.

g.desc: all the way down to cut-off.

g.text: 4.2 V full → 2.1 V at the pin.

g.desc: 4.2 V full → 2.1 V at the pin.

g.text: After SW1, so it draws nothing when off.

g.desc: After SW1, so it draws nothing when off.
